title: FindOrDie - Challange
description: FindOrDie is a fast-paced Minecraft challenge plugin where players must complete random tasks like collecting items, visiting biomes, defeating mobs, or unlocking achievements within a 5-minute timer . Play solo or compete in multiplayer
body:
# **FindOrDie**

You have 5 minutes to complete a random challenge… or you die 💀

## **Modes:**


● 📦 Get a specific item

● 🌍 Reach a biome

● ⚔️ Kill a mob

● 🏆 Complete an achievement


The first rounds are easy 👍 after that it’s fully random 🎲

Complete it → next round 🔁
Fail → spectator 👻

---

## **🏆 Score System**
Track how many challenges you’ve completed.
Use `/fod stats` to check your score.

## **🚫 Smart Filter**
Early rounds avoid hard targets.

* No Ender Dragon at the start
* No Deep Dark early
* Better overall progression

## **🥇 Multiplayer Mode**

● /fod blocks → solo

● /fod blocks multiplayer → multiplayer

All players get the same task.
First to finish wins the round and gets a point.

---

**Note:** Minecraft 1.21.11 "Mounts of Mayhem" added Nautilus, Zombie-Nautilus, Nautilus armor, spears, and Netherite horse armor. These aren’t yet in the Mob/Item pools, but the plugin works fine and they can be added later if desired.
